notes.title: Input changes, Secondary Target functionality and visual updates to Levels
notes.content:
[b]Inputs has changed slightly![/b]
[list]
[*] The character now auto runs
[*] You now need to hold a specific input to walk
[*] The input to slide has changed as well
[*] Using the Camera Flash has changed input location
[/list]


[b]New Tutorial Level![/b]
[list]
[*] After feedback, the tutorial has changed from a linear-ish level to a more "free-form" level where you can explore the game's mechanics a bit more
[*] [i]Besides, the previous level had some issues with assets loading in that caused some initial hiccups [/i]
[/list]


[b]Taking pictures of "Secondary Targets"[/b]
[list]
[*] Has changed name to "Clue(s)" instead
[*] Outside the "tutorial level", taking pictures of the "Clues" now adds some time to the game timer
[*] Instead of randomly choosing a "mesh" when the game starts, "Clue(s)" now will have (depending on the level) a dedicated mesh & color depending on the level and area of the level
[/list]


[b]Levels[/b]
[list]
[*] All levels had some visual updates to the sky
[*] Adjusting the placements of certain level meshes
[/list]
